reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified. The handler handle_blobs_by_root_request_inner (rpc_methods.rs:289-366) processes BlobsByRoot requests without checking current_epoch against FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS. The spec (01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json, PROP-6a4369e9-inv-035) explicitly requires: 'blob_sidecars_by_root must be fully deprecated after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS' with assertion 'current_epoch >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS => respond_empty_or_reject'. The constant MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS=4096 exists in config.yaml but is never referenced in any Rust code. No epoch-based deprecation logic exists in the handler. This is a spec violation for Fusaka-specific P2P protocol requirements. Severity downgraded from Medium to Low: while this is a real protocol non-compliance issue that will cause resource waste on deprecated endpoints post-Fusaka, the impact is limited to individual node resource consumption (not network-wide consensus or security). Per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE severity definitions, this affects protocol compliance and resource efficiency but does not meet the >5% network impact threshold for Medium (which requires ability to 'bring down more than 5% of the network'). The missing deprecation causes nodes to continue serving deprecated requests, wasting resources, but does not enable network attacks.
